title: Abateze amatwi bavuye mu bitaboneka .
intro: Hirya y’igitambaro c’isi iboneka, hari ikoraniro ryihishije ryari rikoraniye mu mwiza, ryikwegerewe n’ijwi ryari riteye akagere ivyo bari bazi vyose. Bari bamaze imyaka myinshi bagendagenda ata buyobozi nyakuri bafise, gushika aho ijwi ryitobekeranya mu gacerere k’aho bari bataboneka, rikavyura ikintu kiri imbere cane. Ijoro ry’uyu musi, muratumiwe gutera intambwe kure y’ibitutu no guhishura akaranga k’uwo mugwi w’akabanga, uwo guhura kwawo n’amajambo y’Imana kwatumye basubira mu bantu babo nk’ababuzi b’ukuri kutashobora guhagarara.
clues: Turi ibiremwa vya kera, vyabayeho kera cane imbere y’amahanga menshi mwasomye, yamara rero ntituvugwa cane mu nkuru z’abantu.
Kamere yacu itandukanye n’iyawe, iboshe mu bintu bitaboneka, kandi dufise ububasha butera ubwoba ibisanzwe.
Twaramaze imyaka myinshi tugendagenda ata buyobozi nyakuri dufise, gushika aho ijwi ridushikira rivyura ikintu kiri imbere cane.
Twumvise ugusubiramwo nk’aho ata co twigeze twumva, amajambo yari afise uburemere burenze invugo iyo ari yo yose.
Twarafatanya mu mpisho, tugategeka abacu guceceka, kandi iyo imirongo irangira, ntitwashobora guhagarara.
Twarasubiye ku bantu bacu, tuvuga tuti: «Ewe bantu bacu, twumvise Igitabu cahishuriwe inyuma ya Musa, cemeza ivyari imbere yaco, kiyobora ku kuri.»

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
